input.title: Add offline progress saving for the puzzle game
body: Players can now finish a level without a connection. The game saves progress on the device after every level and sends it to the server the next time a connection is available.
What changed
- Progress is written to local storage when a level ends.
- On start-up the game compares local and server progress and keeps the newer one.
How it was checked
- The new save and restore tests pass: see the test report in the [CI run](https://example.com/ci/runs/1842).
- Played levels 1 to 5 in airplane mode on a physical phone, then reconnected. Progress synced once.
Closes #214. The design is in `docs/adr/0012-offline-saves.md`.

input.title: Validate trading data before backtesting
body: Backtests now stop before they start when the price table has a missing trading day, a price of zero, or timestamps that go backwards.
What changed
- A validation step runs on the price table and reports every failed check with its row number.
- The backtest command exits with an error when any check fails.
How it was checked
- One fixture table per failure type and one clean table. Output: [test run](https://example.com/ci/runs/2210).
- Re-ran last quarter's backtest. Results are unchanged because that table was already clean.
Closes #187.

input.title: Fix the random seed so training runs can be repeated
body: Two training runs with the same seed now give the same scores. Before this change the data shuffling used its own unseeded generator.
What changed
- The seed set at the start of `train.py` is now passed to the shuffling and to the model initialization.
- The seed is printed at the start of each run so it can be reused.
How it was checked
- Ran the script twice with seed 7 on the sample data and compared the scores: identical to six decimals. Logs are in `reports/seed-check/`.
- This was checked on one machine only. Results on a different GPU are not covered.
Closes #301.
